warnings.why: A youth literacy ratio of 1.19 (significantly more literate young women than young men) is implausible given Yemen's severe gender inequality, conflict, and generally low female education access.
A ratio of 1.18 is unusually high and likely reflects a data collection artifact or outdated administrative reporting rather than actual gender parity trends in youth literacy.
